lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 예배에 처음 왔는데 좀 긴장돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. It's my first time at a service, so I'm a bit nervous.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. yebaee cheoeum wanneunde jom ginjangdwaeyo.
lines.learner: 어서 오세요. 저는 이 교회 신자 김민준이에요.
lines.en: Welcome. I'm Kim Minjun, a believer at this church.
lines.roman: eoseo oseyo. jeoneun i gyohoe sinja gimminjunieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. When should I stand up?
lines.learner: 찬송과 기도는 거룩한 까닭에 일어서서 해요.
lines.en: Hymns and prayers are holy, so we stand for them.
lines.roman: chansonggwa gidoneun georukan kkadalge ireoseoseo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Should I turn off my phone during the sermon?
lines.learner: 네, 설교에 집중하려고 다들 꺼 둬요.
lines.en: Yes, everyone turns them off to focus on the sermon.
lines.roman: ne, seolgyoe jipjunghallyeogo dadeul kkeo dwoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do I have to give an offering?
lines.learner: 아니요, 꼭 안 해도 돼요. 마음이 중요해요.
lines.en: No, you don't have to. It's the heart that matters.
lines.roman: aniyo, kkok an haedo dwaeyo. maeumi jungyohaeyo.

lines.en: It's the Bible. You can open it and read along.

lines.beaver_en: Is it very different from a Catholic Mass?
lines.learner: 비슷하지만 미사는 순서가 더 정해져 있어요.
lines.en: It's similar, but Mass has a more fixed order.
lines.roman: biseutajiman misaneun sunseoga deo jeonghaejyeo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 예배 말고 다른 행사도 교회 방식으로 합니까?
lines.beaver_en: Besides services, do you do other events the church way too?
lines.beaver_roman: yebae malgo dareun haengsado gyohoe bangsigeuro hamnikka?
lines.en: We also hold weddings and funerals the church way.

lines.beaver: 절에서 하는 의식과도 비슷한 점이 있네요.
lines.beaver_en: It seems to have some things in common with temple rituals.
lines.beaver_roman: jeoreseo haneun uisikgwado biseutan jeomi inneyo.
lines.learner: 네, 종교는 달라도 예절은 비슷한 면이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, religions differ, but their etiquette has similarities.
lines.roman: ne, jonggyoneun dallado yejeoreun biseutan myeoni isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 이 교회 자리가 명당이라는 말을 들었어요.
lines.beaver_en: I heard this church sits on an auspicious site.
lines.beaver_roman: i gyohoe jariga myeongdangiraneun mareul deureosseoyo.
lines.learner: 그건 속설이에요. 선교를 위해 처음 세운 곳이에요.
lines.en: That's just a popular belief. It was first built for missionary work.
lines.roman: geugeon sokseorieyo. seongyoreul wihae cheoeum seun gosieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you for explaining so kindly.
lines.learner: 별말씀을요. 예배 끝나고 차 한잔 하세요.
lines.en: Not at all. Have a cup of tea after the service.
lines.roman: byeolmalsseumeullyo. yebae kkeunnago cha hanjan haseyo.
